mapper.sql: log.id AS log_id, log.event_id, log.occurred_at, log.operator_ref AS actor, log.action_code, log.resource_type, log.resource_id, log.result_code, log.request_id, CAST(log.before_state AS CHAR) AS before_json, CAST(log.after_state AS CHAR) AS after_json, CAST(log.metadata AS CHAR) AS metadata_json
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_audit_log (event_id, operator_ref, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, request_id, before_state, after_state, metadata, occurred_at) VALUES (#{record.auditId}, #{record.operator}, #{record.action}, #{record.resourceType}, #{record.resourceId}, #{record.result}, #{record.requestId}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{metadataJson}, #{record.occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM iam_audit_log WHERE event_id = #{auditId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_audit_subject_link (audit_log_id, subject_type, subject_id, relation_code) VALUES (#{auditLogId}, #{subject.subjectType}, #{subject.subjectId}, #{subject.relation})
